about.title: About Me
about.quote: What I enjoy most is taking a feature all the way: understanding the problem, building the integration, and making sure it runs safely in production.
about.p1: I'm Isaac Martinez, a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Santiago, Dominican Republic. At SERHANT I work end to end on S.MPLE, an AI platform for real estate agents, across iOS and Android, the agent PWA, the advisor dashboard and the core API.
about.p2: Over 5+ years I've gone from freelancing to building tooling and leading a team of three at Minnek, real-estate systems at VPM Solutions, and AI systems at WGSN. Along the way I learned to treat production safety as a default and developer experience as part of the product.
about.p3: I'm open to Senior Full Stack roles and to opportunities to lead. If you need someone who owns the outcome, not just the ticket, let's talk.

serhant.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
serhant.description: Working end to end on S.MPLE, an AI platform for real estate agents, across iOS and Android (Expo), the agent PWA, the advisor dashboard and the core API. Owned the Canva Connect integration, ran safe production backfills, built automatic delivery of AI-generated content, and improved the team's developer experience.

highlights.canva: Owned the Canva Connect integration (OAuth + Autofill) and turned it into a shared driver reused across features.
highlights.delivery: Built automatic delivery of AI-generated content with retries, human hand-off and a reconciliation sweep.
highlights.backfill: Ran a production backfill over tens of thousands of rows: dry-run by default, canary, verified rollback, zero failures.
highlights.dx: Shipped a one-command local setup and fixed CI out-of-memory type-checking by moving to TypeScript 7.

wgsn.title: Full Stack Developer (AI & Data-Driven Systems)
wgsn.description: Maintained and optimized an internal predictive model that produces forecasts and insights from business reports. Built an AWS Lambda service with WebSocket streaming for real-time chatbot responses.

vpm.title: Full Stack Developer
vpm.description: Maintained and extended a real-estate platform. Improved candidate search with an optimized ranking that surfaces the most relevant profiles. Built custom reports and dashboards that give company owners insight into business performance, and admin panel tools for the Admin, Support and Marketing teams.

lead.description: Led a dynamic team of three software engineering professionals. Achieved significant improvements in performance and code maintainability for prominent clients like Your Store Wizards and Conectando. Focused on fostering a collaborative and continuous learning environment.

mid.title: SE2 (Mid) Full Stack Engineer
mid.description: Developed full-stack solutions using modern technologies and best practices. Contributed to various client projects with focus on code quality and responsiveness.

junior.title: Full Stack Engineer
junior.description: Developed e-commerce for BigCommerce stores with 20k+ products and thousands of automated events a day. Created Cominnek, a Go CLI for conventional commits linked to Jira from the branch name. Built internal dashboards using Vue, Express and MongoDB.

ysw.title: Full Stack Engineer

selfEmployed.title: Web Application Developer
